title: Why Do Cuts Heal? Your Body's Tiny Super Bandage!

lines.text: Ouch! You tripped on the playground and got a bright red scrape!
lines.caps: *OUCH! You tripped on the *PLAYGROUND | and got a bright red *SCRAPE!

lines.text: Deep inside your bloodstream, emergency sirens begin to wail!
lines.caps: Deep inside your *BLOODSTREAM, | emergency sirens begin to *WAIL!

lines.text: Millions of tiny disc-shaped builders called platelets rush to the rescue!
lines.caps: Millions of tiny *BUILDERS | called *PLATELETS | rush to the *RESCUE!

lines.text: They stick together tightly, locking arms like a superhero shield wall!
lines.caps: They stick together *TIGHTLY, | locking arms like a *SUPERHERO | shield *WALL!

lines.text: Then they weave tough sticky threads called fibrin to trap red cells!
lines.caps: Then they weave tough sticky *THREADS | called fibrin to trap *RED | *CELLS!

lines.text: In just a few hours, the net dries into a tough, protective brown scab!
lines.caps: In just a few *HOURS, | the net dries into a *TOUGH, | protective brown *SCAB!

lines.text: Underneath the scab roof, fresh new skin cells grow happy and smooth!
lines.caps: Underneath the scab *ROOF, | fresh new skin cells grow *HAPPY | and *SMOOTH!

lines.text: Your amazing body can heal itself from the inside out every single time!
lines.caps: Your amazing body can *HEAL | itself from the inside out *EVERY | single *TIME!

lines.text: Celebrate your body's superpowers—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
